name.zh: 川陕—嘉陵江—懋功

description.zh: 红四方面军由川陕根据地西渡嘉陵江，经剑门关、江油、北川等地西进，与中央红军在懋功会师。
description.en: The Fourth Front Army crossed the Jialing River from the Sichuan–Shaanxi base, advanced west through Jianmen Pass, Jiangyou, and Beichuan, and met the Central Red Army at Maogong.

name.zh: 懋功—两河口—卓克基—毛儿盖—班佑—巴西—包座（红四方面军北上）

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 19 日懋功会师后，红四方面军一部随中央北上：6 月 26 日两河口会议，6 月底攻占卓克基，7 月中旬进至黑水芦花，下旬抵毛儿盖。8 月混编为左、右两路军后，右路军红 30 军、红 4 军为右翼由洞哑、腊子山入草地，红 1 军为左翼由毛儿盖经曲定桥入草地；8 月 24—27 日先后出草地到班佑、巴西，8 月 29—31 日发起包座战役；9 月上旬右路军在巴西、包座地区休整待命，至 9 月中旬奉命南下。原线把 1936 年甘南—会宁段并入同一条线，现拆分。路线为示意。
description.en: After the Maogong link-up on 19 June 1935 part of the Fourth Front Army moved north with the centre: the Lianghekou meeting on 26 June, Zhuokeji taken at the end of June, Luhua in mid-July and Maoergai later that month. After the two front armies were regrouped into left and right columns in August, the right column’s 30th and 4th Corps entered the grasslands via Dongya and Lazishan while the 1st Corps went via Maoergai; by 24–27 August they reached Banyou and Baxi and on 29–31 August fought the Baozuo battle; in early September the right column rested at Baxi and Baozuo until ordered south in mid-September. The former line merged the 1936 Gannan–Huining leg into the same route and has now been split. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 包座—绥靖—丹巴—懋功—宝兴—天全—芦山—百丈（红四方面军南下）

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 8 日张国焘电令右路军准备南下，15 日以红军总政治部名义发布《大举南进政治保障计划》，左路军自阿坝、右路军红 4 军与红 30 军自包座重过草地南下，9 月下旬集结马塘、松岗、党坝；10 月 5 日在卓木碉另立「中央」。10 月 7 日发布《绥崇丹懋战役计划》，12 日克绥靖，16 日克丹巴，20 日克懋功；10 月 24 日由懋功翻夹金山，11 月 1 日占宝兴、10 日占天全、12 日占芦山，11 月 16 日占百丈，19—21 日百丈决战失利后撤至天全、芦山、宝兴。原线起点误置懋功、日期误置 9 月 8 日。路线为示意。
description.en: On 8 September 1935 Zhang Guotao ordered the right column to prepare to move south; on 15 September the General Political Department issued the “plan for the great southward advance”, and while the left column came south from Aba the right column’s 4th and 30th Corps recrossed the grasslands from Baozuo, assembling around Matang, Songgang and Dangba in late September; on 5 October a separate “central committee” was set up at Zhuomudiao. On 7 October the Suijing–Chonghua–Danba–Maogong plan was issued: Suijing fell on 12 October, Danba on 16 October and Maogong on 20 October. On 24 October the army crossed the Jiajin mountains from Maogong, taking Baoxing on 1 November, Tianquan on 10 November and Lushan on 12 November, and Baizhang on 16 November; after the defeat at Baizhang on 19–21 November it withdrew to Tianquan, Lushan and Baoxing. The former route started wrongly at Maogong on 8 September. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 名山—宝兴—丹巴—道孚—炉霍—甘孜（红四方面军西进康北）
name.en: Mingshan–Baoxing–Danba–Daofu–Luhuo–Ganzi (Fourth Front Army moves west to Kham)

description.zh: 红四方面军由天全、芦山、宝兴经懋功、丹巴西进，翻越党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口，经道孚、炉霍进抵甘孜。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The Fourth Front Army moved west from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing via Maogong and Danba, crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass of Dangling Mountain, and advanced through Daofu and Luhuo to Garzê. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 木黄—南腰界—百户司—招头寨—永顺

description.zh: 1934 年 10 月 24 日红六军团与红三军在贵州印江木黄会师，28 日由酉阳南腰界出发，30 日过酉阳城，在百户司（今湖北来凤百福司，一说属咸丰）渡酉水，经湖南龙山招头寨佯动后突然东进，11 月 7 日袭占永顺县城。路线为示意，中间点不代表实际经行地点。
description.en: The Sixth Army Group and the Third Army met at Muhuang, Yinjiang, Guizhou, on 24 October 1934. They left Nanjie in Youyang on 28 October, passed Youyang on 30 October, crossed the Youshui at Baihusi (now Baifusi, Laifeng, Hubei; some accounts place it in Xianfeng), feinted towards Zhaotouzhai in Longshan, then swung east and seized Yongshun on 7 November. The line is schematic and intermediate points are not actual marching locations.

name.zh: 永顺—龙家寨（十万坪）

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 13 日红二、六军团主动放弃永顺县城，向北转移诱敌深入，沿途丢弃旧枪杂物、烧毁城西猛洞河花桥以骄敌；16 日进入龙家寨十万坪谷地设伏。
description.en: On 13 November 1934 the Second and Sixth Army Groups gave up Yongshun and withdrew north to lure the enemy forward, leaving old weapons and burning the flower bridge over the Mengdong river; on 16 November they took up ambush positions in the Shiwangping valley at Longjiazhai.

name.zh: 塔卧—陈家河

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 12 日，红二、六军团主力撤离塔卧、龙家寨向北转移，13 日先头部队进至桑植陈家河，与国民党军第 58 师第 172 旅遭遇并将其包围。
description.en: On 12 April 1935 the main force of the Second and Sixth Army Groups withdrew from Tawo and Longjiazhai and moved north; on 13 April its advance guard reached Chenjiahe in Sangzhi, met the 172nd Brigade of the KMT 58th Division and surrounded it.

name.zh: 沙道沟—高罗—忠堡

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 2 日红二、六军团进至宣恩沙道沟、高罗地区；9 日夜以一部围困宣恩县城，主力待机打援；截获徐源泉令第 41 师张振汉部经忠堡西援宣恩的密电后，12 日凌晨分两路向忠堡急进，14 日在忠堡、构皮岭一带全歼该师师部及第 121 旅，俘张振汉。
description.en: On 2 June 1935 the Second and Sixth Army Groups entered the Shadaogou–Gaoluo area of Xuan’en. On the night of 9 June part of the force besieged Xuan’en while the main force waited to strike the relief column; after intercepting Xu Yuanquan’s telegram ordering Zhang Zhenhan’s 41st Division to relieve Xuan’en via Zhongbao, the main force set out at 3 a.m. on 12 June and on 14 June destroyed the divisional headquarters and the 121st Brigade between Zhongbao and Goupiling, capturing Zhang Zhenhan.

name.zh: 沙道沟—板栗园

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 2 日红二、六军团自龙山兴隆街突然北进至沙道沟佯动，使徐源泉误判红军将打击第 34 师或第 48 师第 142 旅；3 日晨红军改变行动方向，从高罗、李家河之间揳入敌纵深，沿山间捷径向西南疾进，11 时赶至板栗园东侧利福田谷地设伏，12 时许敌第 85 师进入伏击圈，战至 23 时全歼其师部、两个团又 1 个营，击毙师长谢彬。板栗园、利福田为同一战区的代表点。
description.en: On 2 August 1935 the Second and Sixth Army Groups suddenly moved north from Xinglongjie in Longshan to Shadaogou as a feint, leading Xu Yuanquan to expect a strike on the 34th Division or the 142nd Brigade of the 48th Division. At dawn on 3 August the Red Army changed direction, thrust into the enemy depth between Gaoluo and Lijiahe and hurried southwest along mountain paths, reaching the Lifutian valley east of Banliyuan at 11 a.m. The 85th Division entered the ambush around noon and was destroyed by 11 p.m., including its headquarters, two regiments and a battalion; its commander Xie Bin was killed. Banliyuan and Lifutian are representative points in the same battle area.

name.zh: 桑植—便水—石阡—鸭池河—乌蒙山

description.zh: 红二、红六军团从桑植出发，经便水、石阡、鸭池河进入黔西北，再转进乌蒙山。
description.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps moved from Sangzhi through Bianshui, Shiqian, and Yachihe into northwestern Guizhou, then into the Wumeng Mountains.

name.zh: 乌蒙山—盘县—普渡河—石鼓

description.zh: 红二、红六军团经盘县会议决定北上，经普渡河、六甲进入滇西，在石鼓渡过金沙江。
description.en: After the Panxian meeting decided to move north, the Second and Sixth Army Corps passed the Pudu River and Liujia into western Yunnan and crossed the Jinsha River at Shigu.

name.zh: 石鼓—中甸—得荣—巴塘—白玉—甘孜（红二军团）

description.zh: 红二军团由石鼓渡金沙江，翻越雅哈雪山进中甸，经得荣、巴安（今巴塘）、白玉北上甘孜；途中翻越月日茨普、藏巴拉、恶热拉、麦拉、生欧拉等垭口。6 月 18 日恶热拉、麦拉为两路并行，路线合为一条示意线。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The Second Army Group crossed the Jinsha River at Shigu, crossed Yaha Snow Mountain to Zhongdian, and moved north via Derong, Batang, and Baiyü to Garzê, crossing the Yuericipu, Zangbala, Ere, Maila, and Sheng’oula passes. On 18 June the Ere and Maila crossings were made by two parallel columns; the route combines them into one schematic line. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 甘孜—将台堡

description.zh: 示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 道孚—瞻化（四天翻越四座雪山）

description.zh: 红四方面军第四军第十师由道孚经麻孜、亚洛阔、沙拥、伊涅阿、拉日马、扎巴加奔袭瞻化（今新龙），四天连续翻越四座海拔 4000 米以上雪山。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The 10th Division of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army rushed from Daofu via Mazi, Yalokuo, Shayong, Yijiea, Larima, and Zhabajia to Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong), crossing four passes above 4,000 m in four days. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 哈达铺—成县—五龙山—徽县—两当—康县（成徽两康战役）

description.zh: 红二方面军由哈达铺地区东出陇南，分三路攻占成县、徽县、两当、康县，并在成县五龙山阻击追敌。路线为示意，三路分进合为一条线。
description.en: The Second Front Army moved east from the Hadapu area into Longnan in three columns, taking Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian, and blocking the pursuers at Wulongshan in Chengxian. The route is schematic and combines the three columns into one line.

name.zh: 两当—徽县—娘娘坝—罗家堡—磐安—榜罗—通渭—将台堡（红二方面军北撤）

description.zh: 红二方面军由两当、徽县北撤，经天水娘娘坝、礼县罗家堡，在甘谷磐安、礼辛一带强渡渭河，经通渭榜罗镇北上，10 月 22 日到达将台堡与红一方面军会师。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The Second Front Army withdrew north from Liangdang and Huixian, passed Niangniangba in Tianshui and Luojiabao in Lixian, forced the Wei River around Pan’an and Lixin in Gangu, moved north via Bangluo in Tongwei, and reached Jiangtaibao on 22 October to meet the First Front Army. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 通渭—青江驿—界石铺—会宁（红四方面军第四军北进）

description.zh: 红四方面军第四军由通渭北上，10 月 7 日先头两个团抵达会宁县城与红十五军团七十三师会合，10 月 8 日第十师在会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺与红一军团第一师会师，10 月 9 日随总部进入会宁县城。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army moved north from Tongwei; on 7 October two advance regiments reached Huining town and joined the 15th Army Corps’ 73rd Division, on 8 October the 10th Division met the 1st Army Corps’ 1st Division at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu, and on 9 October it entered Huining town with headquarters. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 毕节—野马川—以则河—哲庄坝—黑石头—来宾铺—盘县（乌蒙山回旋）

description.zh: 红二、六军团撤出毕节后，以赫章为中心在黔滇交界乌蒙山区回旋：3 月 2 日野马川会议定策，3 月 8 日以则河伏击樊崧甫纵队先头，3 月 12 日哲庄坝伏击万耀煌第十三师，3 月 19 日跳出包围圈，3 月 23 日来宾铺虎头山与滇军孙渡纵队激战，3 月 28 日进占盘县。路线为示意，逐日折返（三进奎香等）未全部画出。
description.en: After leaving Bijie the Second and Sixth Army Groups maneuvered around Hezhang in the Wumeng Mountains on the Guizhou–Yunnan border: the Yemachuan meeting set the plan on 2 March, the ambush at Yizehe hit Fan Songfu’s advance guard on 8 March, the ambush at Zhezhuangba hit Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division on 12 March, the encirclement was broken on 19 March, Sun Du’s Yunnan troops were fought at Hutoushan near Laibinpu on 23 March, and Panxian was occupied on 28 March. The route is schematic; daily doubling back (including three entries into Kuixiang) is not fully drawn.

name.zh: 陈家河—两河口—桃子溪—桑植

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 14 日红军在陈家河全歼第 172 旅；15 日经两河口、南岔、桃子溪追击南逃的第 58 师师部及第 174 旅，在桃子溪将其全歼；16 日乘胜收复桑植县城。南岔、岩屋口为途中地名，未单列坐标。
description.en: On 14 April 1935 the Red Army destroyed the 172nd Brigade at Chenjiahe; on 15 April it pursued the fleeing 58th Division headquarters and 174th Brigade through Lianghekou, Nancha and Taoziqi and annihilated them at Taoziqi; on 16 April it retook Sangzhi. Nancha and Yanwukou are named in the text but not plotted separately.

name.zh: 忠堡—龙山县城（回师）

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 14 日忠堡战斗结束后，红二、六军团回师湘西，18 日主力云集龙山县城周围，开始围攻龙山。回师具体经行路线史无逐日记载，此处为示意直连。
description.en: After the fighting at Zhongbao ended on 14 June 1935, the Second and Sixth Army Groups returned to western Hunan; on 18 June the main force gathered around Longshan county town and began the siege. The exact line of march is not recorded day by day, so the segment is a schematic direct connection.

name.zh: 板栗园—茨岩塘（回师根据地）

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 3 日板栗园战斗结束后，红二、六军团返回根据地中心地带龙山三元、石羔、桶车、兴隆街、茨岩塘一带休整待命，至 7 日傍晚再出设伏。返回的具体日期与经行史无逐日记载，此处为示意直连，茨岩塘为省委驻地代表点。
description.en: After the fighting at Banliyuan on 3 August 1935, the Second and Sixth Army Groups returned to the central base area around Sanyuan, Shigao, Tongche, Xinglongjie and Ciyantang to rest and wait, moving out again on the evening of 7 August. Neither the exact date nor the route of return is recorded day by day, so the segment is a schematic direct connection; Ciyantang marks the provincial committee base.

name.zh: 桑植—塔卧（苏区内部机动线）

description.zh: 苏区内部常驻线。1934 年 12 月 10 日湘鄂川黔省委、省革委、省军区机关由大庸迁至永顺塔卧，桑植、塔卧同处苏区腹地；1935 年 2 月国民党军郭汝栋纵队占领桑植、李觉部占领大庸，苏区收缩，此线中断（桑植失守具体日期待核，取 2 月末为代表）。
description.en: Internal Soviet-area line. On 10 December 1934 the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou provincial organs moved from Dayong to Tawo in Yongshun, with Sangzhi and Tawo both inside the Soviet heartland. In February 1935 Guo Rudong’s column took Sangzhi and Li Jue’s forces took Dayong, the Soviet area contracted and this line was cut (the exact date Sangzhi fell is unverified; late February is used as a representative date).

name.zh: 塔卧—兴隆街（苏区内部机动线）

description.zh: 苏区内部常驻线。1935 年 4 月 12 日省委、省革委、省军区机关由永顺塔卧迁往龙山兴隆街。
description.en: Internal Soviet-area line. On 12 April 1935 the provincial party, government and military organs moved from Tawo in Yongshun to Xinglongjie in Longshan.

name.zh: 兴隆街—茨岩塘（苏区内部机动线）

description.zh: 苏区内部常驻线。1935 年 5 月 6 日省委、省革委、省军区机关由兴隆街再迁茨岩塘，茨岩塘成为苏区后期中心。
description.en: Internal Soviet-area line. On 6 May 1935 the provincial organs moved from Xinglongjie to Ciyantang, which became the centre of the Soviet area in its final phase.

name.zh: 兴隆街—沙道沟（苏区内部机动线）

description.zh: 苏区内部常驻线。兴隆街（省委驻地）经沙道沟通往鄂西的前出通道，1935 年 6 月、8 月两次出击鄂西均由此进出。
description.en: Internal Soviet-area line. The forward route from Xinglongjie (the provincial committee base) via Shadaogou into western Hubei, used for the two sorties of June and August 1935.

name.zh: 龙家寨（十万坪）—永顺

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 16 日夜十万坪伏击得手后，红军星夜向南追击溃敌，18 日重占永顺县城。
description.en: After the ambush at Shiwangping on the night of 16 November 1934, the Red Army pursued the routed enemy south through the night and retook Yongshun on 18 November.

name.zh: 永顺—桑植

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 18 日红军重占永顺县城，随后以红二军团一部乘胜进占桑植县城。桑植占领日期史载不一：《贺龙年谱》系于 11 月 17 日重占永顺之后，另有记载称 11 月 24 日攻占大庸后接着占领桑植，此处取 11 月下旬为代表。
description.en: The Red Army retook Yongshun on 18 November 1934 and then sent part of the Second Army Corps on to Sangzhi. Sources differ on when Sangzhi fell: He Long’s chronology places it immediately after the retaking of Yongshun on 17 November, while other accounts say it followed the capture of Dayong on 24 November. Late November is used here as a representative date.

name.zh: 茨岩塘—芭蕉坨（设伏）

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 3 日板栗园战斗后，红二、六军团主力回到龙山三元、石羔、桶车、兴隆街、茨岩塘一带休整待命；7 日获悉陶广纵队将经芭蕉坨、凉风洞、欧溪坪、花鹿溪开赴龙山县城，当日傍晚两万红军轻装趁夜奔赴芭蕉坨、凉风洞、欧溪坪、花鹿溪一线设伏。芭蕉坨一带为伏击线代表点。
description.en: After Banliyuan on 3 August 1935 the main force returned to the Longshan base area around Sanyuan, Shigao, Tongche, Xinglongjie and Ciyantang. On 7 August it learned that Tao Guang’s column would march via Bajiaotuo, Liangfengdong, Ouxiping and Hualuxi towards Longshan county town, and that evening some 20,000 troops moved out light-handed to lay an ambush along that line. The point marks the ambush line near Bajiaotuo.

name.zh: 甘孜—阿坝—包座—腊子口—哈达铺—岷州—临潭—通渭（红四方面军北上甘南）
name.en: Ganzi–Aba–Baozuo–Lazikou–Hadapu–Minxian–Lintan–Tongwei (Fourth Front Army north to southern Gansu)

description.zh: 1936 年 7 月上旬红二、红四方面军从甘孜出发，经阿坝、包座，第三次穿越草地，8 月上旬到达班佑、包座和甘南；随后发起岷洮西固战役（8 月 5 日—9 月 7 日），9 月上旬先后占领漳县、临潭、渭源、通渭、岷县、陇西、临洮、武山等地。9 月 16—18 日岷州会议后一部西进临潭（洮州），27 日洮州会议决定北上，红四方面军主力北上通渭一带，10 月上旬进入通渭，随后经青江驿、界石铺转往会宁。路线为示意，班佑、哈达铺至岷州间的具体经行只入正文。
description.en: In early July 1936 the Second and Fourth Front Armies set out from Ganzi, passed Aba and Baozuo and crossed the grasslands for the third time, reaching Banyou, Baozuo and southern Gansu in early August. They then fought the Min–Tao–Xigu campaign (5 August–7 September) and in early September took Zhangxian, Lintan, Weiyuan, Tongwei, Minxian, Longxi, Lintao and Wushan. After the Minzhou meeting of 16–18 September part of the force moved west to Lintan (Taozhou), where the Taozhou meeting of 27 September decided to go north; the main force then moved to the Tongwei area in early October and then via Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu towards Huining. The line is schematic; the exact tracks between Banyou, Hadapu and Minxian appear only in the text.

name.zh: 通渭—华家岭—会宁（红五军后卫阻击）

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月，红四方面军红五军担任全军后卫，由通渭经华家岭向会宁转进，10 月 22—23 日在华家岭大墩梁一带阻击胡宗南部追兵，副军长罗南辉牺牲，掩护主力与会宁的红一方面军会合。路线为示意，华家岭取大墩梁代表点。
description.en: In October 1936 the Fourth Front Army’s 5th Corps served as rearguard, moving from Tongwei via Huajialing towards Huining; on 22–23 October it blocked Hu Zongnan’s pursuing forces at Huajialing and Dadunliang, losing deputy commander Luo Nanhui, and covered the main force’s link-up with the First Front Army at Huining. The line is schematic; Huajialing uses the Dadunliang representative point.
